item.title: on being successful
item.description:
to understand what it means to be successful in life, it is important we first understand success itself.

simply put: success is the accomplishment of a goal.

therefore statistically speaking, to lead a successful life would mean to achieve >50% of our goals. in other words, accomplishing more goals than we fall short of during the course of our lives.

so does success look the same for everyone? yes. like we stated earlier, it is the accomplishment of a goal.

item.title: aren't we all "on a diet"?
item.description:
some of us on one meal a day. some on low-carb. some on keto. the list goes on… and some (read most) of us are on a eat-whatever-you-want diet. a go-with-the-flow diet.

being intentional, deliberate and purposeful versus being unplanned and carefree.

if we sat in a car and started driving with no destination in mind, the odds of us arriving at a nice place are very slim and we’re more likely to end up somewhere we don’t like.
